description: A phasor oscillator giving a falling ramp of the raw phase, meant to feed the phase modulation input of OP, running sixteen polyphonic channels

params.text: Sets the frequency as two raised to twelve times the dial, giving 1Hz at the bottom and 4096Hz at the top
Trims the frequency by a tenth of an octave either way
Scales what the PM input does to the phase, from fully inverted through nothing to fully positive; the dial's travel is cubed and the result reaches 32 radians per volt

inputs.text: Shifts the phase in proportion to its voltage, by the amount the modulation index sets
Raises the frequency by an octave per volt above the FREQ setting; the number of channels patched here is the number of channels the module runs

outputs.text: A falling ramp of the oscillator's phase, running from 3.14V down to -3.14V each cycle

notes: the pitch voltage is clipped at zero, so a negative voltage at V/OCT does not lower the frequency below the FREQ setting

inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage does nothing here.
